Container.Name: shopping-list
Container.Overview: Press: a shared shopping list for the house. Your items grouped by aisle, barcode lookups, links to Tesco and Dunnes, and a browser helper that fills your online basket (it never checks out).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port to open the list on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the list is stored. Back this up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the data folder (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the data folder (100 = users).

Config.Name: MCP token
Config.Description: Optional password for the MCP server at /mcp (for Claude). Set one before the app is reachable from outside your home network.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address you open the list at (e.g. behind a reverse proxy or Tailscale).
